delivery_policy_amounts_check.name: delivery_policy_amounts_check
delivery_policy_amounts_check.value: "delivery_policy_revisions"."version" > 0 and "delivery_policy_revisions"."flat_fee" >= 0 and "delivery_policy_revisions"."flat_fee" = trunc("delivery_policy_revisions"."flat_fee") and ("delivery_policy_revisions"."minimum_products_total" is null or ("delivery_policy_revisions"."minimum_products_total" >= 0 and "delivery_policy_revisions"."minimum_products_total" = trunc("delivery_policy_revisions"."minimum_products_total"))) and ("delivery_policy_revisions"."free_shipping_from" is null or ("delivery_policy_revisions"."free_shipping_from" > 0 and "delivery_policy_revisions"."free_shipping_from" = trunc("delivery_policy_revisions"."free_shipping_from")))

delivery_manual_policy_check.name: delivery_manual_policy_check
delivery_manual_policy_check.value: ("delivery_policy_revisions"."pricing_mode" is null and "delivery_policy_revisions"."conditional_free_enabled" is null and "delivery_policy_revisions"."conditional_free_from" is null and "delivery_policy_revisions"."approval_validity_hours" is null and "delivery_policy_revisions"."evaluation_validity_hours" is null) or ("delivery_policy_revisions"."pricing_mode" is not null and "delivery_policy_revisions"."pricing_mode"='MANUAL_QUOTE' and "delivery_policy_revisions"."conditional_free_enabled" is not null and "delivery_policy_revisions"."conditional_free_from" is not null and "delivery_policy_revisions"."conditional_free_from">0 and "delivery_policy_revisions"."conditional_free_from"=trunc("delivery_policy_revisions"."conditional_free_from") and "delivery_policy_revisions"."approval_validity_hours" is not null and "delivery_policy_revisions"."evaluation_validity_hours" is not null and "delivery_policy_revisions"."approval_validity_hours" between 1 and 168 and "delivery_policy_revisions"."evaluation_validity_hours" between 1 and 720 and "delivery_policy_revisions"."pickup_enabled"=true and "delivery_policy_revisions"."flat_fee"=0 and "delivery_policy_revisions"."free_shipping_from" is null and "delivery_policy_revisions"."minimum_products_total" is null and "delivery_policy_revisions"."is_demo"=false)

delivery_quote_event_check.name: delivery_quote_event_check
delivery_quote_event_check.value: "delivery_quote_events"."actor_kind" in ('USER','GUEST','SYSTEM') and (("delivery_quote_events"."actor_kind"='USER' and "delivery_quote_events"."actor_id" is not null) or ("delivery_quote_events"."actor_kind"<>'USER' and "delivery_quote_events"."actor_id" is null)) and "delivery_quote_events"."type" in ('REQUESTED','ASSIGNED','PROPOSED','APPROVED','CORRECTIONS','REJECTED','CANCELLED','EXPIRED','ACCESS_RECOVERED','ACCESS_REVOKED','ACCEPTED','ORDER_CREATED','PAYMENT_CLOSED') and (("delivery_quote_events"."command_key" is null and "delivery_quote_events"."command_hash" is null) or ("delivery_quote_events"."command_key" is not null and "delivery_quote_events"."command_hash" is not null and length("delivery_quote_events"."command_hash")=64))

delivery_quote_owner_check.name: delivery_quote_owner_check
delivery_quote_owner_check.value: ("delivery_quote_requests"."client_id" is not null and "delivery_quote_requests"."guest_name" is null and "delivery_quote_requests"."guest_email" is null and "delivery_quote_requests"."guest_session_hash" is null) or ("delivery_quote_requests"."client_id" is null and "delivery_quote_requests"."guest_name" is not null and "delivery_quote_requests"."guest_email" is not null and length(btrim("delivery_quote_requests"."guest_name"))>0 and length(btrim("delivery_quote_requests"."guest_email"))>0 and "delivery_quote_requests"."guest_session_hash" is not null and length("delivery_quote_requests"."guest_session_hash")=64)

delivery_quote_state_check.name: delivery_quote_state_check
delivery_quote_state_check.value: "delivery_quote_requests"."status" in ('REQUESTED','ASSIGNED','PROPOSED','APPROVED','REJECTED','CANCELLED','EXPIRED','ORDER_CREATED','CLOSED_UNPAID') and "delivery_quote_requests"."version">0 and ("delivery_quote_requests"."status" not in ('ASSIGNED','PROPOSED') or "delivery_quote_requests"."assigned_to" is not null)

delivery_quote_revision_check.name: delivery_quote_revision_check
delivery_quote_revision_check.value: "delivery_quote_revisions"."version">0 and "delivery_quote_revisions"."amount">=0 and "delivery_quote_revisions"."amount"=trunc("delivery_quote_revisions"."amount") and "delivery_quote_revisions"."kind" in ('PROPOSAL','APPROVED') and ("delivery_quote_revisions"."distance_km" is null or "delivery_quote_revisions"."distance_km">=0) and ("delivery_quote_revisions"."trips" is null or "delivery_quote_revisions"."trips">0) and length(btrim("delivery_quote_revisions"."notes"))>=8 and (("delivery_quote_revisions"."kind"='PROPOSAL' and "delivery_quote_revisions"."valid_until" is null and "delivery_quote_revisions"."source_revision_id" is null) or ("delivery_quote_revisions"."kind"='APPROVED' and "delivery_quote_revisions"."source_revision_id" is not null and "delivery_quote_revisions"."source_revision_id"<>"delivery_quote_revisions"."id" and "delivery_quote_revisions"."valid_until" is not null and "delivery_quote_revisions"."valid_until">"delivery_quote_revisions"."created_at"))

delivery_quote_reason_check.name: delivery_quote_reason_check
delivery_quote_reason_check.value: ("delivery_quote_revisions"."reason"='PAID_FREIGHT' and "delivery_quote_revisions"."amount">0) or ("delivery_quote_revisions"."reason"='FREE_RADIUS' and "delivery_quote_revisions"."amount"=0 and "delivery_quote_revisions"."route_confirmed"=true and "delivery_quote_revisions"."distance_km" is not null and "delivery_quote_revisions"."distance_km"<=5) or ("delivery_quote_revisions"."reason"='FREE_CONDITIONAL' and "delivery_quote_revisions"."amount"=0 and "delivery_quote_revisions"."coordinated"=true) or ("delivery_quote_revisions"."reason"='FREE_EXCEPTION' and "delivery_quote_revisions"."amount"=0)

product_family_events_subject_check.name: product_family_events_subject_check
product_family_events_subject_check.value: "product_family_events"."product_id" is not null or "product_family_events"."family_id" is not null

sale_deliveries_coordinates_check.name: sale_deliveries_coordinates_check
sale_deliveries_coordinates_check.value:
(
        "sale_deliveries"."latitude" is null and "sale_deliveries"."longitude" is null
      ) or (
        "sale_deliveries"."latitude" is not null
        and "sale_deliveries"."longitude" is not null
        and "sale_deliveries"."latitude" between -90 and 90
        and "sale_deliveries"."longitude" between -180 and 180
      )

inventory_movements_actor_or_online_orde.name: inventory_movements_actor_or_online_order_check

online_order_manual_quote_check.name: online_order_manual_quote_check
online_order_manual_quote_check.value: ("online_orders"."delivery_quote_request_id" is null and "online_orders"."delivery_quote_acceptance_id" is null and ("online_orders"."delivery_fee_reason" is null or "online_orders"."delivery_fee_reason" in ('PICKUP','FLAT','FREE_THRESHOLD'))) or ("online_orders"."delivery_quote_request_id" is not null and "online_orders"."delivery_quote_acceptance_id" is not null and "online_orders"."delivery_type"='DELIVERY' and "online_orders"."delivery_fee_reason" in ('MANUAL_APPROVED','MANUAL_FREE_RADIUS','MANUAL_FREE_CONDITIONAL','MANUAL_FREE_EXCEPTION'))

online_orders_delivery_breakdown_check.name: online_orders_delivery_breakdown_check
online_orders_delivery_breakdown_check.value:
(
      "online_orders"."products_subtotal" is null and "online_orders"."products_discount_total" is null and "online_orders"."delivery_fee" is null and "online_orders"."delivery_policy_revision_id" is null and "online_orders"."delivery_fee_reason" is null
    ) or (
      "online_orders"."products_subtotal" is not null and "online_orders"."products_discount_total" is not null and "online_orders"."delivery_fee" is not null and "online_orders"."delivery_policy_revision_id" is not null and "online_orders"."delivery_fee_reason" is not null
      and "online_orders"."products_subtotal" >= "online_orders"."products_discount_total" and "online_orders"."products_discount_total" >= 0 and "online_orders"."delivery_fee" >= 0
      and "online_orders"."total" = "online_orders"."products_subtotal" - "online_orders"."products_discount_total" + "online_orders"."delivery_fee"
      and "online_orders"."delivery_fee_reason" in ('PICKUP', 'FLAT', 'FREE_THRESHOLD', 'MANUAL_APPROVED', 'MANUAL_FREE_RADIUS', 'MANUAL_FREE_CONDITIONAL', 'MANUAL_FREE_EXCEPTION')
      and ("online_orders"."delivery_type" <> 'PICKUP' or ("online_orders"."delivery_fee" = 0 and "online_orders"."delivery_fee_reason" = 'PICKUP'))
    )

online_orders_delivery_data_check.name: online_orders_delivery_data_check
online_orders_delivery_data_check.value:
"online_orders"."delivery_type" = 'PICKUP' or (
        "online_orders"."delivery_recipient_name" is not null
        and length(btrim("online_orders"."delivery_recipient_name")) > 0
        and "online_orders"."delivery_phone" is not null
        and length(btrim("online_orders"."delivery_phone")) > 0
        and "online_orders"."delivery_address" is not null
        and length(btrim("online_orders"."delivery_address")) > 0
        and "online_orders"."delivery_commune" is not null
        and length(btrim("online_orders"."delivery_commune")) > 0
      )

online_orders_delivery_coordinates_check.name: online_orders_delivery_coordinates_check
online_orders_delivery_coordinates_check.value:
(
        "online_orders"."delivery_latitude" is null and "online_orders"."delivery_longitude" is null
      ) or (
        "online_orders"."delivery_latitude" is not null
        and "online_orders"."delivery_longitude" is not null
        and "online_orders"."delivery_latitude" between -90 and 90
        and "online_orders"."delivery_longitude" between -180 and 180
      )

online_orders_owner_check.name: online_orders_owner_check
online_orders_owner_check.value:
(
        "online_orders"."client_id" is not null
        and "online_orders"."guest_name" is null
        and "online_orders"."guest_email" is null
        and "online_orders"."guest_phone" is null
        and "online_orders"."guest_session_hash" is null
        and "online_orders"."guest_device_hash" is null
      ) or (
        "online_orders"."client_id" is null
        and "online_orders"."guest_name" is not null
        and length(btrim("online_orders"."guest_name")) > 0
        and "online_orders"."guest_email" is not null
        and length(btrim("online_orders"."guest_email")) > 0
        and "online_orders"."guest_phone" is not null
        and length(btrim("online_orders"."guest_phone")) > 0
        and "online_orders"."guest_session_hash" is not null
        and length("online_orders"."guest_session_hash") = 64
      )

online_order_items_promotion_snapshot_ch.name: online_order_items_promotion_snapshot_check
online_order_items_promotion_snapshot_ch.value:
(
        ("online_order_items"."promotion_id" is null
          and "online_order_items"."promotion_type_snapshot" is null
          and "online_order_items"."promotion_name_snapshot" is null
          and "online_order_items"."promotion_value_snapshot" is null
          and "online_order_items"."discount_amount" = 0)
        or
        ("online_order_items"."promotion_id" is not null
          and "online_order_items"."promotion_type_snapshot" in ('PERCENTAGE_DISCOUNT', 'BUY_2_PAY_1')
          and "online_order_items"."promotion_name_snapshot" is not null
          and (
            ("online_order_items"."promotion_type_snapshot" = 'PERCENTAGE_DISCOUNT' and "online_order_items"."promotion_value_snapshot" between 1 and 99)
            or ("online_order_items"."promotion_type_snapshot" = 'BUY_2_PAY_1' and "online_order_items"."promotion_value_snapshot" is null)
          ))
      )

client_delivery_addresses_coordinates_ch.name: client_delivery_addresses_coordinates_check
client_delivery_addresses_coordinates_ch.value:
(
        "client_delivery_addresses"."latitude" is null and "client_delivery_addresses"."longitude" is null
      ) or (
        "client_delivery_addresses"."latitude" is not null
        and "client_delivery_addresses"."longitude" is not null
        and "client_delivery_addresses"."latitude" between -90 and 90
        and "client_delivery_addresses"."longitude" between -180 and 180
      )

email_verification_active_user_unique.name: email_verification_active_user_unique
email_verification_active_user_unique.where: "email_verification_challenges"."user_id" is not null and "email_verification_challenges"."consumed_at" is null

email_verification_active_guest_unique.name: email_verification_active_guest_unique
email_verification_active_guest_unique.where: "email_verification_challenges"."guest_session_hash" is not null and "email_verification_challenges"."consumed_at" is null

email_verification_owner_check.name: email_verification_owner_check
email_verification_owner_check.value:
(
        "email_verification_challenges"."purpose" in ('CLIENT_REGISTRATION', 'CLIENT_EMAIL_CHANGE', 'INTERNAL_USER_REGISTRATION', 'CLIENT_REACTIVATION')
        and "email_verification_challenges"."user_id" is not null
        and "email_verification_challenges"."guest_session_hash" is null
      ) or (
        "email_verification_challenges"."purpose" in ('GUEST_CHECKOUT','GUEST_DELIVERY_REQUEST','GUEST_DELIVERY_ACCESS')
        and "email_verification_challenges"."user_id" is null
        and "email_verification_challenges"."guest_session_hash" is not null
        and length("email_verification_challenges"."guest_session_hash") = 64
      )

customer_notice_validity_check.name: customer_notice_validity_check
customer_notice_validity_check.value: "customer_notice"."starts_at" is null or "customer_notice"."ends_at" is null or "customer_notice"."ends_at" > "customer_notice"."starts_at"

promotions_percentage_check.name: promotions_percentage_check
promotions_percentage_check.value:
(
        ("promotions"."type" = 'PERCENTAGE_DISCOUNT' and "promotions"."percentage" between 1 and 99)
        or ("promotions"."type" = 'BUY_2_PAY_1' and "promotions"."percentage" is null)
      )
